name: lens
description: C++ comprehension workbench for C engineers: journal, structure, flow, rosetta, layout and cost lenses.

commands.title: Lens: Export Journal to Single Markdown

viewsWelcome.contents:
No open questions yet.

When you hit C++ you don't understand, put your cursor on the symbol and flag it. The list of things you don't yet understand is your ramp-up plan.

[Flag an Open Question](command:lens.annotateWtf)

Nothing due for review.

Entries resurface on a decaying schedule so you can check whether they still surprise you.

lens.journalPath.description: Workspace-relative folder holding journal entries. Markdown is the source of truth; commit this folder.

lens.reviewIntervals.description: Days until an entry resurfaces, indexed by confidence level. Once confidence exceeds the last interval the entry retires.

lens.showGutterIcons.description: Show a gutter marker on annotated symbols.

lens.symbolProviderTimeoutMs.description: How long to wait for the language server to return document symbols. The first request for a large translation unit can take many seconds while clangd parses it and its headers.

lens.clangUml.path.description: Path to the clang-uml binary. Leave as the bare name to use PATH.

lens.clangUml.timeoutSeconds.description: How long to let clang-uml run before giving up.

lens.compilationDatabase.description: Path to compile_commands.json, or to the directory holding it. Accepts a differently named file such as compile_commands_fixed.json. Empty searches the workspace, build/, out/, Debug/, Release/ and .vscode/.

lens.structure.namespaces.description: Restrict structure diagrams to these namespaces. Empty means no namespace filter.

lens.structure.excludeNamespaces.description: Namespaces to exclude from structure diagrams. Vendor SDK namespaces belong here.

lens.flow.maxDepth.description: How many call levels to follow from the selected function.

lens.flow.maxNodes.description: Stop expanding once the call tree reaches this many functions.

lens.flow.depthWarning.description: Warn when a call chain exceeds this many frames. Embedded stacks are small.

lens.flow.isrPatterns.description: Extra regular expressions identifying interrupt handlers, beyond the CMSIS names and *_IRQHandler.

lens.clang.path.description: Path to a clang or clang++ binary used for AST analysis. It need not be your build compiler, but it must understand your build flags.

lens.clang.timeoutSeconds.description: How long to let a clang AST dump run before giving up.

lens.pahole.path.description: Path to pahole (from the dwarves package). Used to cross-check predicted layouts against the DWARF your compiler actually emitted.

lens.pahole.objectFile.description: Workspace-relative path to a .o or .elf built with -g. Without it, layouts are shown as predicted only and internal holes are not computed.

lens.cost.elfFile.description: Workspace-relative path to the linked, unstripped ELF. Leave empty to search for *.elf, *.axf or *.out.

lens.trace.file.description: Workspace-relative path to a trace, in the format produced by `uftrace replay -f duration,tid` or by your own -finstrument-functions decoder.

lens.complexity.warn.description: Cyclomatic complexity above which a function is flagged.

lens.complexity.depth.description: Control-flow nesting depth above which a function is flagged.

lens.dwarfdump.path.description: Path to llvm-dwarfdump. Works on Windows, reads polymorphic classes that pahole cannot, and ships with the LLVM you already use for lens.clang.path.

lens.observedLayout.provider.description: Which tool supplies observed member sizes and internal holes. 'auto' prefers llvm-dwarfdump, which is portable and handles polymorphic classes.

lens.clangUml.gitWorkaround.description: Some clang-uml versions require a git repository and fail otherwise. When the project is not under version control, run clang-uml from a scratch repository inside .lens/cache. Nothing is written outside .lens/.

lens.extraCompileFlags.description: Flags added to every compile command Lens builds, e.g. ["-DSTM32G474xx", "-DUSE_HAL_DRIVER"]. Use this when your compilation database is missing defines the project needs — without the vendor device macro, every CMSIS header fails.

scripts.package: npm run typecheck && npm run build && vsce package
